description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.6.3-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed Newest Albums First resetting after going Back
- Fixed gaps and stutter between songs on Linux
- Fixed MP3 track edges including encoder padding and garbled starts
- Fixed short tracks going silent
- Fixed saving lyrics sending your lyrics file to the Recycle Bin
- Fixed Account page deleting an account with one click
- Fixed Account page creating an API key without asking
- Fixed pairing turning sync on unexpectedly
- Fixed server staying on after switching it off
- Fixed sync ID changing on every save
- Fixed sync changes made while off not applying when turned back on
- Fixed renaming the PC not reaching signed-in phones
- Fixed signed-out phones not being removable
- Fixed Share Lyrics option changes being slow
- Fixed Share Lyrics Save Card delay
- Fixed Share Lyrics black text on Artwork background
- Fixed Share Lyrics line jumping when editing
- Fixed Share Lyrics option lists running off the window
- Fixed file names starting with " - " for songs without an artist
- Fixed Share Lyrics messages not following app language
- Fixed lyrics background text colours over some covers
- Fixed lyrics background gradients showing a green band
- Fixed saved gradient text colours coming back wrong
- Fixed damaged saved colours breaking the artwork background
- Fixed Visualizer frozen when Exclusive Mode is off
- Fixed auto-update never installing on time
- Fixed auto-update crashing on two-part version tags
- Fixed TTML lines with the same start time being shuffled
- Fixed TTML line breaks and indentation showing up in lyrics
- Fixed TTML files with a stray blank line showing no lyrics
- Fixed "Your queue is empty" showing while a song plays
- Fixed played songs not being removable from the queue
- Fixed double-clicking Up Next restarting the queue
- Fixed Liquid Glass letting page text show through the island
- Fixed embedded lyrics fields being ignored
- Fixed saving tags turning timed lyrics into plain text
- Fixed Edit Info creating a stray lrc file
- Fixed shortcut conflicts running two actions on one key
- Fixed phone app sort button staying lit
- Fixed phone app stop sending needing two taps
- Fixed phone app send summary being overwritten
Added
- Added Save Lyrics to File as LRC or TTML
- Added Russian language
- Added Account and Devices reorganised into four groups
- Added phone app card with server switch and phone list
- Added Background Color pop-up with Artwork, Solid and Gradient modes
- Added Gradient Auto that persists across restarts
- Added twelve new rebindable shortcuts
- Added second singer placement in TTML files
- Added .ttml import in Edit Info and Lyrics Studio
- Added Keep Played Songs queue view with Clear Played
- Added Saving lyrics settings section
- Added automatic lyrics download when the lyrics view opens
Improved
- Improved password check protection against flood attempts
- Improved profile name handling against password guessing
- Improved server error messages hiding stack traces
- Improved certificate password storage
- Improved Local API token handling
- Improved sync handling of future-dated changes
- Improved Share Lyrics option speed and dialog behaviour
- Improved lyrics background colour picks
- Improved Settings switches for keyboard and screen reader use
- Improved queue scrolling to the playing song
- Improved About page update timing display
- Improved translations across all ten languages
Full Changelog: v1.6.2...v1.6.3
